# PhoneFarm Fun (phonefarm.fun)

> Factory-built Android device farm hardware from Guangzhou, China — real-device labs for mobile QA, app testing, automation, and B2B deployment.

## About
PhoneFarm Fun is a Guangzhou-based hardware manufacturer (since 2017) supplying real Android device farm boxes, motherboard clusters, multi-device lab racks, lab accessories, and custom rack solutions. We assemble chassis locally, run burn-in QC, and export worldwide.

## Products
- Phone Farm Box — 20-node real Android device chassis (USB+LAN+OTG)
- Motherboard Box — high-density headless Android clusters for QA
- Android Phone Farm — starter QA deployment SKU
- iPhone Phone Farm — iOS lab hardware (quoted per project)
- Real Device Phone Farm — turnkey lab bundle
- Empty Box / Chassis — expansion units
- USB Hub, Power Supply, Cooling Kit, Network Kit — accessories
- Custom Rack Cabinet — 40+ node engineered projects

## Supported device models (examples)
Samsung Galaxy S8, S9, S10, S20, S21 FE, Note 8/9/10 Lite/20, Z Flip3/4; OnePlus 5/8 Pro; Google Pixel 4 XL; Nubia Z17; A908N and other Android SKUs with USB/LAN/OTG routing.

## Services
Phone farm setup & assembly, remote control workstation setup, group control / batch management configuration, bulk device deployment, custom hardware engineering, enterprise rack deployment, maintenance & support, sample hardware evaluation, overseas delivery & export.

## FAQ topics
What is a phone farm box; motherboard cluster vs phone box; real device vs cloud phone; real device vs emulator; Android vs iPhone farm; device capacity per box; custom hardware; remote control; group control; international shipping; MOQ; sample orders; lead time; USDT payment; Samsung model compatibility; creator studio workflows; e-commerce app testing; device management software (ADB-neutral).

## Guides & blog
How to choose a phone farm box; cloud phone vs real device; lab setup guide; motherboard vs phone box; bulk APK deployment; power & cooling for 24/7 labs; phone farming profitability (hardware perspective); creator studio setup; digital marketing device labs; Samsung model compatibility; remote lab management; e-commerce testing at scale.

## Use cases
Creator & content studio; digital marketing labs; e-commerce operations; development & QA testing.
